payload.claim: Criterion 1 requires that 'a runtime that does run reports the version string it printed', but no test in this diff (or anywhere in the suite) exercises `probe()`'s success branch — every test that calls `probe()` supplies either a missing path or a file that raises `OSError`, both of which are caught by the `except CellRuntimeError` branch above line 156 and never reach it. Replacing `done.stdout.strip() if done.returncode == 0 else None` with a bare `None` leaves both existing tests (`test_a_runtime_that_cannot_be_executed_reports_as_absent`) green, yet makes `probe()` report absent even when the selected runtime runs fine — silently turning every `cell`-marked test into a permanent skip on a working host, which is exactly the failure this spec exists to prevent and which no gate or test here would notice.
